62439.subject: Computer Studies
62439.question_text:
(a) (i) What is a network cable?

(ii) State three types of cable used in networking

(b) Write the acronym VSAT in full.

(C) (i) Distinguish between an e-mail address and a website address.

(ii) List examples of each of: (1) e-mail address (2) website address
62439.explanation:
(a) What is a network cable? A network cable is an aggregate of thin lined wires fused together for the purpose of conveying signals between nodes, or

A network cable is a hardware device used to connect or link two or more computers together in order to share resources like printers, scanners or application software, etc.(i) Types of cables used in computer networking: Co- axial cable, Twisted pair cable, Telephone cable, Null modem cable, Ethernet crossover cable and Fibre optic cable.

(b) The acronym VSAT means: Very Small Aperture Terminal

(C)(i) An e-mail address identifies an e-mail box on a network where electronic messages are sent and received; while a website address is a reference to a resources that specifies the location of a document or resources on a computer network.

OR An e-mail ad- dress usually contains the symbol which is never a part of a website while a web address begins with either 'www.or https://

(i) Examples of e-mail address: exams@waec.edu.ng; bofe82@yahoo.com; queen@gmail.com.

Examples of website: www.waec.edu.ng www.waeconline.org; www.google.com

62440.subject: Computer Studies
62440.question_text:
(a) (i) Define computer virus.

(i) List three types of computer network security breach.

(b) State five sources of computer network security breach.
62440.explanation:
Computer virus is a malicious program which replicates itself and causes damage to the resources in the computer, OR

Computer virus is a malware that when executed, replicates itself and infects other programs by modifying them.

(i) Rootkit virus Polymorphic virus and Directory virus (b) Denial of service, Spoofing attack, Tampering at tack, privilege escalation, Eaves dropping, Downloading of files from un-trusted websites, Deliberate divulgence of company's information, Virus, Worms and Trojan horses.

62442.subject: Computer Studies
62442.question_text:
(a) An electronic book is made up of 500 pages and there are 16 lines of 24,000 bits line on each page.

Complete the space it will occupy on a computer in megabytes.

 (b) Give an example of auxiliary storage.

(c) In the table below:

(i) List the two main types of computer software.

(ii) Give two examples under each in 4(c)i)

main type  example
i A
  B
ii A
B
62442.explanation:
a) First method 4.

Total number of pages  = 50

Total number of lines per page = 16

Total number of bits per line =  24,000 bits

Total number of bits in a byte: 8 bits = 1 byte

On each page, there are: 2400 x 16 bytes = 48,000 bytes/page

For 500 pages, there are: 48,000 x 500 bytes

Conversion to Kilobyte = 24000000/1024 = 23437.5KB

Conversion to Megabyte = 23437.5/1024 = 22.89MB

The space occupied in megabyte is 22.89

Second method:

Total number of pages = 500

Total number of lines per page = 16

 Total number of bits per lines = 24,000 bits

Total number of bits in a byte: 8 bits = 1 byte

A line in bytes = 24000/8 = 3000 bytes

16 lines = 16 x 3000 bytes = 48000 bytes

1 page in kilobytes = 48000/1024  = 46.875KB

Total space occupied = 500 x 46.875KB = 23437.5KB

Since 1024KB = 1MB

Then total space Occupied in Megabyte

23437.5KB /1024 = 22.8882MB

(b) Auxiliary Storage Hard disk / Hard drive, Compact Disc (CD), Digital Versatile Disc (DVD), Magnetic Tape, Floppy Disk/ Diskette, Pen Drive Flash Drive, Blue ray disk, Memory card or SD-card, Zip drive, Sim card.

(c)(i) Two main types of computer software System Software, Application Software.

(ii) Examples of System Software
1. Operating system: MS windows, Linux, Unix, Mac OSX, DOs, IOS, Novel.

2. Utility software: Virus scanner/ Anti-virus, Disk fragmenter, System monitor, File manager, Device driver, Disk cleaner.

3. Linker.

4. Language translator:Assembler, Interpreter and Complier

Examples of Application Software 1. Specialized software: Application Payroll Program Education Management Software, Accounting Soft- ware, Statistical Software, Web Design Software (e.g Facebook, Skype), etc.

2. Application packages: Microsoft office suite, Word processing, Graphics software, Game software, Database software, Spreadsheet software, Steam software (game), etc.
